prompt:
Subject: Direct animal-to-human rabies transmission in an educational illustration.

Composition: Show one non-graphic educational cutaway of a dog muzzle contacting an adult hand with a shallow skin break. A saliva droplet bridges the mouth and broken skin; enlarged schematic bullet-shaped rabies particles within that droplet make the animal-to-human infection route explicit, without blood.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. No text, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands.
en: The diagram illustrates zoonotic transmission as infected dog saliva contacts a break in human skin.
ja: 感染した犬の唾液が人の皮膚の傷に触れる図で、人畜共通伝染病の感染経路を表しています。
